macros.name: hvqrset
macros.doc: With \hvqrset one can set the optional arguments globally.

macros.name: hvqrurl
macros.doc: With the default macro \hvqrurl the URL is printed as as QR code into the margin and in the the text as usual with the macro \url , for example https://mirror.ctan.org/pkg/hvqrurl .
